2–4 hours (not counting the Queen of the Banshees Quest)

A talking pig on a farm in Thais says she is a cursed princess who only the world's best kisser can save. To perfect your technique you have to help six NPCs scattered around Tibia (and kiss the Queen of the Banshees). In the end the pig confesses she is just a pig… but reveals where the sword {item:Firlefanz} is hidden.
An evil witch has cursed Princess Shantalla to live as a pig until the best kisser in the world gives her a kiss.
Farm south of the Thais magic shop (pig NPC)
Level 60 (for the Queen of the Banshees' kiss); 70 recommended.
Have completed all the seals of {wiki:The Queen of the Banshees Quest} (you need a kiss from the queen).
for {npc:Budrik}; the dwarves in the Dwarf Mines drop picks
buy from {npc:Boozer} in Venore (10 gold); melts in ~2 minutes
Some gold for {npc:Zebron}'s dice games (25 gold for each loss)
After learning to mow the lawn (*lawn mowing*) in {npc:Hoggle}'s yard (section 2): only then can you cut the grass at the entrance.
When you give 5 {item:Pick|Picks} to {npc:Budrik} in the Dwarf Mines ({key:hi}, {key:pick}, {key:yes}), in the Dwarven Ghost part.
You can do the missions in **any order**. You only need to talk to the pig at the start and at the end (his answers change with each mission, if you are curious).
If you have already kissed the Queen of the Banshees before, you do not need to repeat it.
If you go to Venore in person, do {npc:Zebron}'s mission first and only then buy the ice cream, so it does not melt.
If an NPC does not reply as in the dialogues, you have probably already done that part.

Go to the **Thais** farm, south of the magic shop. Among the pigs there is one that is an NPC. Say {key:hi}, {key:kiss} and {key:yes}. He says you are still far from being the best kisser: you have to ask several NPCs to teach you.
Go to {npc:Hoggle}'s fishing hut, far to the north-east of Thais. Say {key:hi}, {key:garden} and {key:yes}: he pays you 5 gold to cut the grass in his garden.
Cut the grass in the yard

Go through the sealed door of the garden and use the {item:Machete} on the {item:Jungle Grass}. Cut your way to the square that is **1 north and 7 west** of the sealed door. There the orange message *"You advanced in lawn mowing."* appears.
The message "You advanced in lawn mowing"
Go back to {npc:Hoggle} and say {key:hi} and {key:garden}. You receive 5 {item:Gold Coin|Gold Coins}.
Getting to the Femor Hills tower

{wiki:Femor Hills} lies between **Carlin**, **Ab'Dendriel** and **Kazordoon** (east of Carlin). Take a boat to Carlin (from Thais, {npc:Captain Bluebear}: {key:hi}, {key:carlin}, {key:yes}) and continue on foot to the **east**; bring a {item:Rope} (and, for some routes, a {item:Shovel}). Now that you know how to cut grass, you can cut the fast-growing grass in {wiki:Femor Hills}. Look for the {wiki:Femor Hills Tower|tower} blocked by grass, cut through it with the machete and climb to the top floor.
On the top floor, talk to {npc:Caramellia}. Say {key:hi}, {key:Winfred}, quote his letter with {key:True love never dies} and confirm with {key:yes}.

Go down the tower by the same stairs and walk back the same way to **Carlin** (or head to Ab'Dendriel or Kazordoon, which are also close). In Carlin, {npc:Captain Greyhound} takes you back to Thais ({key:thais}).

In **Ab'Dendriel**, talk to {npc:Elvith}: {key:hi} and {key:kiss}. He only shares his secrets with those who impress him with a love poem. To get to Ab'Dendriel, at the Thais harbour say {key:hi}, {key:ab'dendriel}, {key:yes} to {npc:Captain Bluebear}; to come back, {npc:Captain Seagull} takes you to {key:thais}.
Buy {item:Blank Poetry Parchment|Blank Poetry Parchments} from {npc:Olrik}, the Ab'Dendriel postman, in the southernmost building in the city. Buy several.

Use the {item:Inkwell} on the parchments until you get a perfect poem (about 4 attempts). Look at the parchment: the good one says *"Roses are red, violets are blue, sugar is sweet and so are you.' Excellent!"*

You can only write on the parchments between the two conversations with Elvith. He keeps the poem, so make more than one if you want to keep any. If you cannot use the inkwell, you have already done this part.
Go back to {npc:Elvith} and say {key:hi}, {key:poem} and {key:yes}.

In **Venore**, look for {npc:Zebron} beneath the depot. Say {key:hi}, {key:kiss}, {key:worthy} and {key:yes} to play dice. You have to win **3 times in a row**: keep saying {key:yes} for each game. Winning costs nothing; each loss costs 25 gold and resets the count. To get to Venore, at the Thais harbour say {key:hi}, {key:venore}, {key:yes} to {npc:Captain Bluebear}; to come back, {npc:Captain Fearless} takes you to {key:thais}.
Buy the ice cream in Venore
In **Venore**, go up to the top floor of the depot and talk to {npc:Boozer}. Say {key:hi}, {key:buy Venorean ice cream} and {key:yes}. It costs 10 gold.

The {item:Ice Cream Cone (Venorean Dream)} melts in about **2 minutes**, even inside the depot. You can also ask someone in Venore to buy it and send it to you, but you have to hand it in straight away.
Delivering the ice cream to Lynda
Run (or ask someone who is already in Thais) to the **Thais** temple and talk to {npc:Lynda}: {key:hi}, {key:venorean ice cream} and {key:yes}, before the ice cream melts.
6. A favour for the Dwarven Ghost

The {wiki:Dwarf Mines} are **west** of Kazordoon. The entrance that takes you to {npc:Budrik} and the {wiki:Grothmok Tunnel} is on the surface (see coordinate). Once inside, walk a little to the **north** and go down the hole; Budrik is on the first underground floor. Bring the {item:Rope} so you can climb back up.
Map of the route to the Grothmok Tunnel

In the {wiki:Dwarf Mines}, talk to {npc:Budrik} (in the north-westernmost mine). With 5 {item:Pick|Picks} in your backpack say {key:hi}, {key:pick} and {key:yes}. You gain access to the {wiki:Grothmok Tunnel}.
{creature:Dwarf|Dwarves} drop picks and there are some in the {wiki:Daily Respawns} at the mine entrances: you do not need to bring them from the city.

Go down to the fifth floor (4 floors below Budrik). **South** of the rope hole there is a room (the one you have just gained access to). At the far end is {npc:A Dwarven Ghost}. Say {key:hi}, {key:kiss} and {key:favour}. Route from Budrik: go **west**, follow the lower passage and go down another hole; go straight down the nearest hole (2 squares away); go **west** (there are {creature:Dwarf Soldier|Dwarf Soldiers} and {creature:Poison Spider|Poison Spiders}) and go down one more hole; pass 3–4 {creature:Dwarf Guard|Dwarf Guards}, walk a little **south** and, to the **west**, is the sealed door of the Grothmok Tunnel (with 5 {creature:Ghost|Ghosts} inside).
It has to be {key:favour} with the British spelling: {key:favor} does not work.

Go back the same way: on each floor return to the hole you came down and use the {item:Rope} to climb up, all the way to the surface entrance. Kazordoon is just to the **east** (enter through the main mountain entrance).
Bring a {item:Fire Bug} and go to his room in **Kazordoon**, west of the {wiki:Upper Barracks}. Inside there is a chest and a coal basin.
The Dwarven Ghost's room: note the chest and the basin
Open the chest and take the fake dwarven beard. Use the {item:Fire Bug} on the coal basin to light it (it stays lit for about 2 minutes) and use the beard on the basin while it is lit.
In a group, the basin only needs to be lit once: each player just has to burn their own beard.

Go back to {npc:A Dwarven Ghost} and say {key:hi} and {key:beard}. To get there, repeat the route through the Dwarf Mines to the Grothmok Tunnel; afterwards leave again with the {item:Rope} through the same holes.
Getting to the Carlin sewer bar

To get to Carlin, at the Thais harbour say {key:hi}, {key:carlin}, {key:yes} to {npc:Captain Bluebear}. In **Carlin**, enter the sewers right opposite the depot and head **south** to the underground bar, where {npc:Toothless Tim} is.
To understand what Tim says you have to be drunk: drink 3 containers of alcohol ({item:Beer}, {item:Wine}, {item:Rum} or {item:Mead}). {npc:Karl}, nearby, sells mugs of beer for 20 gold each.
Still drunk, say {key:hi}, {key:kiss}, {key:yes} and {key:yes} again to {npc:Toothless Tim}.
Head back **north** the same way to the entrance opposite the depot and climb up to the streets of Carlin. {npc:Captain Greyhound} takes you back to Thais ({key:thais}).
8. The Queen of the Banshees' kiss
If you have already kissed the queen, skip this part. You need to have completed all the seals of {wiki:The Queen of the Banshees Quest} and be level 60 or higher.

The queen is at the bottom of the {wiki:The Queen of the Banshees Quest|Ghostlands dungeon}, **west** of Carlin: go down the entrance hole (see coordinate) and follow the route from that quest's guide to her (she is near the Seal of Sacrifice). Go to {npc:The Queen Of The Banshees}, guarded by 4 {creature:Banshee|Banshees} and many other creatures. Say {key:hi}, {key:kiss} and {key:yes}.
On the way to the Queen of the Banshees

Below level 60 the queen says you are not experienced enough and will not kiss you. The route has {creature:Warlock|Warlocks}, {creature:Demon Skeleton|Demon Skeletons}, {creature:Stalker|Stalkers} and other undead.

If after the kiss you are teleported to a small room with a *"your dead body"*, go up the stairs: you are back on the surface of the Ghostlands. If not, go back the same way, using the {item:Rope} on the holes. From the Ghostlands walk **east** to Carlin and take {npc:Captain Greyhound}'s boat to Thais ({key:thais}).

With all the missions done, go back to the pig in Thais and say {key:hi}, {key:kiss} and {key:yes}. Hearts appear and he confesses that there is no curse, but he tells you where an ancient sword is hidden. You receive the achievement **Passionate Kisser**.
Opening the chest in the cellar
Walk a few steps **west** to the farmhouse and go down to the cellar. Open the chest to receive the {item:Firlefanz}.
Firlefanz chest in the farm cellar
If you had already done the Queen of the Banshees Quest before this quest existed, that does not stop you from completing it.
When the quest was released there was a bug that allowed you to finish it without kissing the queen; it has been fixed and is no longer possible.
